explanation.text: The Constitution was signed on 17 Sept 1787 and the Bill of Rights was ratified on 15 Dec 1791 (~4.2 years). Congress proposed the amendments on 8 June 1789 (or approved them on 25 Sept 1789) and they were ratified on 15 Dec 1791 (~2.2 years). Since the first interval is longer than the second, the claim is true.
